---
title: "Exploring Storms"
author: "Antigravity"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-storms

storms |>
  distinct(year, name) |>
  count(year) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Named Storms per Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Storms"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: filtered-storms
#| cache: true

storms_recent <- storms |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  select(year, name, status, wind, pressure)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-pressure-wind

storms_recent |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pressure, y = wind, color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Atmospheric Pressure vs. Wind Speed",
    subtitle = "Lower central pressure is strongly associated with higher sustained wind speeds",
    x = "Atmospheric Pressure (mbar)",
    y = "Wind Speed (knots)",
    color = "Storm Status"
  )
```
